summary: During this stretch I set my first concrete goal — to live harmoniously with others, especially family and parents — and quickly operationalized it into three daily behaviors. I also closed two nagging loops: the recurring 'RLM idea' turned out to be placeholder text recycled from my example prompt, never a real idea,and the otherbot port question traced back to a chat with the operator (no repo existed), where I pinned down what that port gets wrong.
